channels.how: Post on-hand styling Reels twice weekly opening on fabric movement in natural light. First post is a calm earthy try-on of the fall drop basics worn around Austin.
channels.why_category: Shoppers for everyday linen want to see movement and fit on real bodies before they trust and order.
channels.why_data: Your Reels averaged 8239 reach at 2.39 vs feed.

channels.how: Share on-hand grid photos twice weekly with capsule pairing notes in caption. First post is the fall drop tile restyled on hand in soft daylight.
channels.why_category: Buyers save clean flat and detail shots to plan capsule outfits and return to buy later.
channels.why_data: Feed posts averaged 3449 reach with 165 saves.

channels.how: Use daily polls and try-on clips with link stickers for fall basics. First Story is a poll on which linen color to restock next.
channels.why_category: Regulars tap Stories for restocks and behind-seams trust before ordering staples.

channels.how: Post short fit questions and slow-fashion notes a few times weekly. First post asks how followers style everyday cotton basics for fall.
channels.why_category: Linen buyers join calm Threads chats for fit advice and honest reviews before ordering.

channels.how: Hold TikTok until Reels winners exist, then repost one proven on-hand clip to test. First test would be the best fall try-on with a hook in the opening moment.
channels.why_category: New viewers need quick worn hooks to trust soft basics without feeling the fabric.
channels.why_data: 45% of US adults 30-49 use TikTok, but we have no brand results there yet.
